title: A licensee may not refuse to compound customary simple or moderate non-sterile preparations, except upon extenuating circumstances or by a waiver of Board regulation
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(15), a licensee may not refuse to compound simple or moderate non-sterile compounded preparations customary to the community needs except upon extenuating circumstances or by a waiver of Board regulation. The paragraph does not define simple, moderate, customary to the community needs or extenuating circumstances, and it states no referral, notification or documentation requirement.
exam_relevance: Tests the preparations 247 CMR 9.01(15) reaches and its two stated exceptions.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

exceptions: By a waiver of Board regulation.
common_confusions: The paragraph speaks only of simple or moderate non-sterile compounded preparations customary to the community needs; it says nothing about sterile or complex non-sterile preparations.
The paragraph states two exceptions: extenuating circumstances and a waiver of Board regulation.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
